name: re-tool
description: Assistente de engenharia reversa para JavaScript/Electron (M0: search/pos/line)

scripts.build: npm run build:core && npm run build:tui && npm run build:cli
scripts.test: npm run build:core && npm run build:tui && npm run test -w re-tool-core && npm run test -w re-tool-tui
scripts.smoke: npm run build && node packages/cli/dist/index.js search token --file sample.js
